nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [You've found all the items. You've found Yipp. But something about them is uncertain — like they haven't fully decided what they are yet.]

nodes.speaker: Yipp
nodes.text: You found the things. Both of them. The symbol and the glass.

nodes.speaker: Yipp
nodes.text: Most people who find Yipp only bring one. Or none. You brought both.

nodes.speaker: Yipp
nodes.text: The holy symbol wants Yipp to be... good. Pure. Saint-ish. The wine glass wants Yipp to be something else.

options.text: Be who you want to be.
The wine glass. Embrace the darkness.

nodes.speaker: Yipp
nodes.text: Yipp hasn't thought about it that way.

nodes.speaker: Yipp
nodes.text: Yipp thinks... Yipp will figure it out as Yipp goes.

nodes.speaker: Yipp
nodes.text: Pure. Yes. Yipp can be that. Yipp will try very hard.

nodes.speaker: Yipp
nodes.text: The other thing. Yes. Yipp has always been better at the other thing.

nodes.speaker: Yipp
nodes.text: Don't worry. Yipp is on your side. Mostly.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [Yipp joins the party. Whatever they become, they become it with you.]
